title: Why am I tired after enough sleep?
subtitle: Evidence-based answer to the common question: why am i tired after enough sleep?
evidence_strength: Established evidence supports the multifactorial causes of tiredness after sufficient sleep, including the impact of sleep quality, architecture, sleep disorders, and circadian rhythm alignment. Emerging evidence highlights the role of lifestyle and medical comorbidities. Limitations include variability in self-reported sleep measures and need for more longitudinal studies.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
